k_awake.speaker: King
k_awake.text: Finally awake, Casimir. After yesterday's feast, I thought you would never wake up.

c_generosity.speaker: Casimir
c_generosity.text: Your generosity is surpassed only by your wisdom, sire. I won't go hungry for days.

k_strength.speaker: King
k_strength.text: You will need that strength, envoy. I have received news that the dig has been going well, but a little problem has been found. And by little, I do in fact mean little. It appears the diggers have breached a small goblin encampment.

c_buggers.speaker: Casimir
c_buggers.text: Those green buggers? I thought the Emperor had rid us of that menace.

k_orders.speaker: King
k_orders.text: On the surface the Emperor might have, but underground the job falls to us. I have sent some guards to the dig site. I want you to go help them rid it of the goblins and report the outcome of this little endeavor. Once the site is cleared, report to the Foreman and then come straight to me.

choices.text: "Where will I find the dig site?"

k_where.speaker: King
k_where.text: Leave through the kitchen. The big door there opens onto the road, and the road leads down to the dig. Follow the noise of the picks.

k_sword.speaker: King
k_sword.text: Good. You will find your sword near the dig site, just by the Quartermaster's shop. On your way, soldier, and may God light your path.
